fields.pay_low_usd/pay_high_usd: what to pay for a Near Mint copy, as a range
fields.pay_source: book = live listings · band/mark = past sales · book_thin = 1-2 listings
fields.trust: green 5+ sales · amber 1-4 · red none · conflict sales vs listings disagree
fields.conflict_ratio: sale mark divided by listing midpoint, when they disagree by >2x

caveats: Prices are ranges, not quotes. Nothing here is advice.
A red row has no sales behind it at all.
Sales and listings agree within 50% about 3 times in 4 where both exist.
